buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any

responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Purchase Preference (Centre) Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises whose credentials are validated online through Udyog Aadhaar/URC for that product/service category. If the bidder wants to avail the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DPS/MRPU/3/3/24338 SAMPLE Non-returnable, free of cost sample should be submitted at the consignee location. Assistant Stor es Officer, Receipt Section, Central Stores Unit, DPS/IGCAR, Kalpakkam. Pin- 603 102, af ter placement of purchase order. Bulk supply only after approval of sample. Sample shall be supplied by th e successful bidder within 7 days from the date of is sue of purchase order and acceptance/rejection of the sample can be given within 7 days from the date of receipt of sample at the user division. ANNEXURE-1 TO TENDER REF.NO.DPS/MRPU/3/3/24338 Additional Terms Conditions (For any future correspondence, please mention our reference No. along with the bid num ber) 1. As per public procurement policy to avail purchase preference under Micro and Small Enter prises (MSE’s) bidders are requested to upload the relevant documents along with bid in rel evant place i.e. MSE Status. Non uploading of the documents in relevant place may lead t o lose the opportunity to match L1 price and award of contract as per purchase preference under MSE policy. 2. If any firm is claiming purchase preference on the basis of Micro/ Small Manufacturer, the bidder should upload both the certificates as follows in the relevant column of GeM portal: i. UDYAM registration certificate with all details is only acceptable ii. Self declaration/OEM certificate explicitly stating whether the bidder is the actual manuf acturer of the quoted primary product duly stamped & signed by the authorized signatory o f the company. 3. . IMPORTANT PLEASE MAKE SURE AND FURNISH DECLARATION/UNDERTAKING FOR THE F OLLOWING WHILE SUBMITTING YOUR BID/OFFER ONLINE TO CONSIDER YOUR OFFER:

I. YOU HAD FULLY UNDERSTOOD THE SCOPE OF SUPPLY, SPECIFICATION AND ALL BID CON DITIONS. II. NO COMPROMISE IN QUALITY OF THE QUOTED ITEM. III. THERE IS NO DEVIATION FROM BID SPECIFICATION. IV. UNCONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE OF ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER BID DOCUMENT . V. RATES SHOULD NOT BE DISCLOSED IN TECHNICAL PART IN CASE OF TWO PACKET BID. VI. NO COUNTER CONDITIONS AGAINST THE BID TERMS AND CONDITIONS. Note: You are hereby confirming the following by submitting online bid/offer that: a. you have fully understood scope of supply, specification and all Bid conditions b. there is no deviation from Bid specification and c. unconditional acceptance of all the terms and conditions governed by the General Te rms and Conditions of GeM and terms as per ATC. 4. Delivery Instructions for Suppliers/Transporters: I. Delivery Timings & Working Hours: a. IGCAR, Kalpakkam works for 5 days in a Week (Saturday & Sunday are weekl y-offs). b. Material delivery can be accepted only in working days (Monday-Friday) excl uding Public Holidays between 10:00 Hrs, to 15:00 Hrs. c. Supplier/Transporter should report at Main Gate, IGCAR, Kalpakkam well in ti me, so as to complete the security checks and deliver the material as per the schedule. In case they reach the Site after 3 p.m on any working day or holida y the lorry is liable to be detained overnight till next working day when nece ssary unloading facilities could be organized and the consignment unloaded. Please also note that, no detention charges will be payable by us if the Lorrie s are detained overnight due to the above reasons. II. The Packages should be securely packed and details regarding Purchase Orde r/GeM Contract reference, complete address of Consignor/Consignee (with Contact details) should be clearly marked on all the packages. III. When dispatching multiple orders, material of each order should be packed i n separate package, and details regarding Order reference should be clearl y marked. IV. OTP based deliveries are not possible inside IGCAR/DAE Units. Hence dispatch of material shall be through standard transporters, WITHOUT OTP. V. In the event of dispatch through Speed Post, the date of actual delivery/

physical collection will be considered as Delivery Date. VI. The personnel accompanying the supply (visiting IGCAR) should carry valid original Govt ID Proof and details of the personnel should be intimated in advance, for arran ging entry permit. VII. Drivers should carry original valid Transport Driving License, original Gov t ID Proof and Aadhar card and Vehicles should possess all the required valid Ori ginal Road Documents, such as RC, Insurance, Fitness and etc., otherwise the vehicl es will not be permitted inside plant for delivery. VIII. Vehicles with GPS tracking are not permitted inside DAE Units . IX. Prior intimation/communication has to be sent to the consignee, well in advance, wi th complete details of material including Purchase Order/GeM Contract Number, No of Packages, Volume & weight and contact details of transporter/driver by email. X. Contact Details for advance intimation regarding delivery: a. For IGCAR: i. Tel Nos: 044-27480079 & 27480213 (Direct) and ii. Board: 044-27480500 Extension: 22362/22642/22779 iii. Email-IDs: stores@igcar.gov.in, asortwo@igcar.gov.in .
